resources.string: Play Mind is a collection of board and brain games. Ads are shown by Google AdMob. Diamonds are virtual and have no cash value.

Drag to move · pinch to zoom

Endless board. Five in a row wins; blocked at both ends doesn\'t count.
The classic game of kings and strategy.
Generals, cannons and a river to cross.

• Home: pick a topic card or any game below it. Tap See more to list every game in a topic.
• Diamonds: check in once a day for +1 diamond. Each game gives you 1 free play per day; after that every game costs 1 diamond. Winning gives +1 diamond.
• Win streaks: 5 wins in a row in one game give +2 diamonds, 10 in a row give +3.
• Loyalty bonus: with more than 10 diamonds and a check-in streak above 7 days, your daily check-in gives +2.
• Play against the computer (you always move first), with a friend nearby (no internet), or online by exchanging a room code or QR.
• Rooms: if nobody joins your room, an opponent is added automatically. Opponents in rooms may be computer-controlled.
• Change language and nickname in Settings.

Goal: make five or more of your marks in a row, across, down or diagonally. X (dark) moves first.
• The board is endless: drag with one finger to move around, pinch to zoom.
• If both ends of your line are blocked by enemy marks, it does not count.
• Tap an empty cell to place your mark. Block your opponent's open threes and fours!

Goal: checkmate the enemy king.
• Pawns step forward and capture diagonally. Knights jump in an L. Bishops slide diagonally, rooks slide straight, queens do both, kings step one square.
• Special moves: castling, en passant and promotion on the last rank.
• Tap a piece, then a highlighted square. A game is drawn by stalemate, repetition, the 50-move rule or too few pieces.

Goal: checkmate the enemy general. Red moves first.
• The general and advisors stay inside the palace. The two generals may never face each other on an open file.
• Elephants move two points diagonally, cannot cross the river and can be blocked at the midpoint.
• Horses move like an L but are blocked by an adjacent piece. Chariots slide straight.
• Cannons slide straight and capture by jumping over exactly one piece. Soldiers step forward, and sideways after crossing the river.
• A player with no legal move loses. Repeating a position three times is a draw in this app.
Internet play uses a free STUN server. A few networks block direct connections. If it fails, try Nearby play or play against the computer.
